name: Elmify Master's & Scholarship FAQ (50+ Countries Worldwide)

faqs.question: Is Elmify available in Azerbaijan, and is it free for students?
faqs.answer: Yes. Elmify is available in English, Azerbaijani, and Russian, with local application-fee budgeting in AZN, EUR, GBP, and USD. Creating an account, uploading your transcript and CV, and getting your matched postgraduate programmes and scholarships is free during early access.

faqs.question: Which countries, scholarships, and degrees do you cover?
faqs.answer: We cover English-taught and local-language postgraduate degrees across 50+ countries worldwide (Europe, the UK, North America, Turkey, and Asia), paired with national and bilateral scholarships (Azerbaijan's State Program / Dövlət Proqramı 2022–2028, HTP / Stipendium Hungaricum, DAAD, Swedish Institute SISGP, Chevening, Fulbright, Türkiye Bursları, NL Scholarship), Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters, automatic university and faculty tuition waivers, regional household-income grants, multilateral bloc funds, local-language private foundations, and paid departmental RA/TA assistantships.

faqs.question: Does Elmify cover Bachelor's programmes too?
faqs.answer: Master's degrees (MSc, MA, LLM, MRes) and postgraduate scholarships are live today, and Bachelor's degree support will be done soon — so every credit rule, GPA conversion, deadline, and funding check is tailored to your profile.

faqs.question: How is Elmify different from traditional agencies and generic AI tools?
faqs.answer: Most traditional agencies fall into two traps: some take a fee upfront and deliver rushed, low-quality applications to a handful of partner universities, while others hand your file to a recent graduate who got into one famous university (like Cambridge or Oxford) to write every motivation letter outside their field while using ordinary ChatGPT to search for programmes and scholarships. Ordinary ChatGPT misses niche local-language funding, cannot verify your transcript's ECTS subject credits against 40-page faculty regulations, and frequently guesses rules or invents facts. In Elmify, every admission and scholarship requirement links to the exact sentence on the official university or funder webpage across 50+ countries, and your tailored CV, programme-specific motivation letters, and referee briefs are built directly from your uploaded documents and profile.

faqs.question: How does Elmify prepare my CV, motivation letter, and reference briefs?
faqs.answer: From your uploaded transcript, existing CV, certificates, and profile answers, Elmify builds a tailored academic CV formatted for your target country (German Tabular, Europass, or standard academic CV), a programme-tailored motivation letter anchored to each department's faculty and courses, scholarship essays, and distinct talking-point briefs for each of your referees so two recommenders never repeat the same story.

faqs.question: Do you submit applications for me?
faqs.answer: No. You stay in your own browser and press submit yourself on the official university or scholarship portal. Our glass-box browser extension opens beside DreamApply, uni-assist, Studielink, and university portals, autofills your verified profile answers and attaches your tailored PDFs, flags any portal-specific question, and stops before the Submit button.

faqs.question: What happens to my data?
faqs.answer: Your transcripts, CV, and profile answers are used solely to match postgraduate programmes and prepare your application documents. You can export your documents or permanently delete your account and files from Settings at any time.
